question: The total surface area of a closed cube is given as 1152 cm². What is the length (in cm) of each side of the cube?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Surface Area of a closed cube = 6a²

6a² = 1152

a² = 192

a = √192 = 8√3 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 8√3 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5937194028c9bb230c7df55d7f4a22430bdc502d2cee0cb657e122f05e0c0bce.png] 

**Given:**

Total surface area of the closed cube = 1152 cm²

**Formula Used:**

Total Surface Area of a cube = 6a²

where 'a' is the length of the side of the cube.

**Calculations:**

⇒ 6a² = 1152

⇒ a² = 1152 ÷ 6

⇒ a² = 192

⇒ a = √192

⇒ a = √(64 × 3)

⇒ a = 8√3 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 8√3 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Lateral Surface Area

The lateral surface area includes only the 4 side faces of the cube, excluding the top and bottom faces. Formula: LSA = 4a².

Volume of a Cube

The volume represents the total three-dimensional space enclosed by the cube. Formula: Volume = a³.

Main Diagonal of a Cube

The longest straight line segment that can be drawn inside a cube connecting two opposite corners. Formula: Main Diagonal = a√3.

Face Diagonal

The diagonal line extending across any single flat, square face of the cube. Formula: Face Diagonal = a√2.
